name: Users - Authorized - Internal User Suffixes [ends with]
description: Intent: Authorized internal user / email suffixes — populate with every corporate domain you operate, including legacy variants in active use (e.g., @acme.com, @acme.co.uk, @acquired-co.com, @corp.acme.local). Drives the Internal/Authorized side across 29+ consumers including all 1xxx Web datasets/policies (M1010–M1071), 2xxx Cloud Storage, M3010 internal email, W3000 / B3000, and W2010. Top priority — highest-impact list in the v0 system. Exclusions: do not add contractor or partner domains; do not add deprecated domains you no longer route mail to.
